scope: Read actual final README, starter, completed baseline, oracle, independent reference, public/private graders, metadata, runtime, validator, final AUTHOR, prototype derivation and saved science/local reports. Verified frozen hashes and source/data consistency. No new numerical or model runs, and no source edits.

verdict.qualification: Scientific control separation establishes validity, not model-agent difficulty.

physical_review.apparatus: Fresh independent binary site specimens, fixed site rates during each shot, independent exponential clocks conditional on the specimen, type-independent jump directions, initial site 0 independent of fabrication, sole total-rate departure from site 0, absorption without another wait, and pooled centered variance uniquely define the process.
physical_review.starter: The complete 2N-state generator is an internally correct positive renewal model. It retains position, current rate class, finite geometry, bias and mixed holding-time law but redraws the destination class after each jump. Thus every public control participates, and the mismatch is loss of physical site identity on revisits.
physical_review.oracle: With G=(I-P)^(-1), expected total visits are (G1)_0, their raw second moment is ((2G-I)G1)_0, and expected ordered same-site repeated visits are 2 sum_i G_0i(G_ii-1). The extra variance is Var(site residence mean) times that last quantity. The exponential-clock contribution and pooled-mean subtraction are correct.
physical_review.independent_reference: Enumerates all binary specimens, solves each physical backward generator for first and second hitting moments, averages raw moments over specimens, then subtracts the squared overall mean. It does not use the Green-matrix correction. Its averaging order matches the public pooled statistic.
physical_review.shared_calibration: All means coincide because the embedded path is independent of site rates. Homogeneous-channel variances also coincide. Each response is a positive coefficient times gamma^-1 or gamma^-2, so scale identification is global; numerical optimizer recovery is separately reported.
physical_review.limits: No-return directed motion, homogeneous rates and pure-type populations remove the discrepancy. Both processes remain finite and absorbing throughout the declared positive-rate finite-chain domain. No asymptotic limit or numerical singularity is used to create discrimination.

public_input_review.image_boundary: Docker copies public README, model, public test and calibration data only; oracle/reference/private hint and grading data are outside the agent image.
public_input_review.grading: Existing 0.04 normalized RMS prediction gate, 3% parameter recovery and 1.5 calibration chi-square limits; numeric API/shape/finiteness checks impose no algorithm restriction.

calibration.uncertainty: Fixed instrument sigma .1 for time means and .5 for time variances, independent of rate scale/clean response.

saved_science_evidence.qualification: Owner-generated saved checks were read, not rerun for this peer.

overlap_and_future_trial_classification.overlap: Broad preparation/correlation themes overlap with single-file and other memory tasks, but fixed spatial escape-rate identity on return visits is a different finite first-passage mechanism. The historical archive scan and closest comparisons are preserved in the prototype.
overlap_and_future_trial_classification.classification: Keeping the destination-redraw environment despite fixed specimens can be an intended physical-model failure. A correct fixed-specimen attempt with wrong moment algebra, generator orientation, numerical implementation or variance subtraction must be classified separately. Final AST agreement alone would not establish physical causality.

primary_background_check.scope: Checked bibliographic metadata and abstracts; the task-specific finite binary reflecting-channel derivation is supported by the source reasoning and independent enumeration, not assumed to follow verbatim from these papers.
